title: 第二十八章 狭路相逢第二十九章 内涵装13
content_zh:
吱嘎！
林昆一脚刹车踩住，小QQ猛的晃了一下，章小雅被晃的一个趔趄，脑袋差点撞在了车窗上，回过头幽怨的看着林昆：“林大哥，你干嘛呀！”
林昆嘴角邪意的一笑，向她伸出手，两根手指轻佻的挑起她的下巴：“你说呢？”
章小雅浑身一个寂静，刚才说要缠上人家的那股子促狭劲儿彻底没了，紧张的道：“林……林大哥，这……这样不好吧，这……光天化日……”
“你刚不是说要缠上我么？”
“不不不……”
“晚喽。”
林昆脸上的表情更生动了，双眼碧光闪烁，坏笑着就向章小雅扑了过来。小妮子紧张的赶紧闭上了眼睛，两只手抱在胸前，身体死死的靠在车门上。
说到底，章小雅毕竟还是个雏儿，在男女的那档子事儿上完全不谙世事，这突然要把她给XXOO了，也由不得人家小姑娘不紧张、害怕。
车厢里仿佛突然变的安静了，空调吹着冷风呼呼的声音，偶尔窗外驶过的汽车的轮胎在马路上留下的沙沙声，还有就是自己砰乱的心跳声。
章小雅轻轻的动了动下巴，身体紧张到僵硬，只要稍微一动，似乎就能听到骨节发出的嘎嘣声，身上没有任何的压迫感，她缓缓的睁开眼睛，却看见林大哥正惬意的叼着根烟卷，一脸得意坏笑的看着她……
脑袋里短暂的空白，章小雅马上反映过来，原来他是故意吓唬自己呢！
同时，她白皙的脸颊也迅速的绯红起来，想到自己刚才……真是羞死人了！小丫头把头深深的埋了下去，经过这么一折腾，彻底的蔫吧了。
林昆得意的一笑，效果达到，他堂堂漠北的狼牙兵王，怎么可能被一个小姑娘给调戏了，从来都是只有他耍别人流氓的份儿，哪有倒过来的时候。
章小雅不服气也不行，谁让人家比她更‘氓’高一筹呢？
小QQ开到了北城区的汽车城，全中港市百分之八十的4S店都集中在这，所以买车到这儿来是首选，按照章小雅的指示，林昆把车开到了一个宝马4S店的门口。
小QQ往人家宝马4S店门口一停，马上就有那么一点万绿从中一点红的意思，周围停的都是些至少二十万以上的A级车，唯独它这么一个国产的低级车，而且颜色还喷的那么鲜艳，想不惹人注意都难。
门口站着的保安看了一眼小QQ后，眼神里都露出了不屑鄙夷的意思，门口站着的那几位品貌端正的销售人员就更不用说了，除了鄙夷跟不屑之外，其中一个亭亭丽人的女销售员竟忍不住的掩嘴讥笑道：“咯咯，真是笑死人了，看那小玩具车……”
另一个站在旁边的男销售不屑的低声笑道：“这年头，什么人都敢来逛宝马。”
旁边一个还算稳重的销售员小声说：“行了行了，注意形象，被领导看见了又要扣工资了。”

几个销售员马上表情收敛，等林昆和章小雅推门进来，一起微笑着说道：“欢迎光临……”
然后，再就没了下文，没人主动上前带着两人去看车，也没有人主动问一句：“请问二位有什么需要帮忙的么？”，几个人整齐的站在门口，像是一个个面带冷笑的雕塑，他们心里想的很简单，没人愿意在另个明显不可能买车的人身上浪费唾沫，殊不知就因为他们这会儿的势利眼，白白的就丢掉了一个超级大客户。
林昆和章小雅有些没搞清楚状况，两人以前又都没逛过4S店，心说难道这逛4S店跟逛超市一样？看好哪一样商品了，直接捡进篮子里就行？可买车毕竟跟逛超市不一样啊，需要有人引导介绍才行，这……
两人正疑惑着，这时4S店的门口开来了一辆黑色的雷克萨斯轿车，车上下来一男一女，两人穿着时髦，一身的珠光宝气，女的戴着一个遮了半边脸的大墨镜，左手握着一个精致的橘色手包，右手挽着男人的胳膊，男的脖子上拴着一根金光闪闪的大金链子，脸上也戴着大墨镜。
这一看档次就不一样，门口的几个销售员，顿时就像打了鸡血一样，一个个眼睛唰的亮了起来，看着迎面而来的男女，就好像是见了财神爷一样。
“欢迎光临！”
同样的招呼对白，但接下来完全就不一样了，马上就有销售人员走上前，礼貌恭敬的微笑道：“先生，女士，请问二位有中意的车型么？”
另一个女服务员也上前微笑说：“或者，我们先带二位挨个车型看看？”
content_en:
Squeak!
Lin Kun stepped on the brakes and the little QQ shook violently. Zhang Xiaoya was staggered and her head almost hit the car window. She turned around and looked at Lin Kun resentfully: "Brother Lin, what are you doing!"
Lin Kun smiled evilly, stretched out his hand to her, and raised her chin with two fingers: "What do you think?"
There was silence all over Zhang Xiaoya. The narrow-mindedness that she had just said she wanted to entangle with others was completely gone. She said nervously: "Lin...Brother Lin, this...isn't this good? This...in broad daylight..."
"Didn't you just say you wanted to haunt me?"
"No no no..."
"It's late."
The expression on Lin Kun's face became more vivid, his eyes flashed with green light, and he rushed towards Zhang Xiaoya with a wicked smile. Xiao Nizi closed her eyes nervously, clasped her hands on her chest, and leaned against the car door.
After all, Zhang Xiaoya is still a young child, and she is completely ignorant of the world of men and women. Now that she is suddenly being handed over to someone, she cannot help but be nervous and scared.
The car seemed to suddenly become quiet, with the sound of the air conditioner blowing cold wind, the occasional rustle of tires on the road from passing cars outside the window, and the sound of my own pounding heartbeat.
Zhang Xiaoya moved her chin gently, her body was so tense that she could hear the cracking sound of her joints. She didn't feel any pressure on her body. She slowly opened her eyes and saw Brother Lin holding a cigarette happily and looking at her with a smug smile on his face...
There was a brief blank in her head, and Zhang Xiaoya immediately realized that he was trying to scare her on purpose!
At the same time, her fair cheeks quickly turned crimson. Thinking of herself just now... she was so embarrassed! The little girl buried her head deeply. After all this torment, she felt completely wilted.
Lin Kun smiled proudly, and the effect was achieved. How could he, the majestic Wolf Fang Soldier King of Mobei, be molested by a little girl? He had always been the only one who played other people as a gangster, and there was never a time when it was the other way around.
It’s okay for Zhang Xiaoya not to be convinced. Who can make anyone more ‘rascally’ than her?
Little QQ drove to the Auto City in Beicheng District. Eighty percent of the 4S stores in Hong Kong are concentrated here, so it is the first choice to buy a car here. Following Zhang Xiaoya's instructions, Lin Kun drove the car to the entrance of a BMW 4S store.
As soon as Xiao QQ stopped in front of the BMW 4S store, he immediately felt that it was a bit green and a bit red. There were A-class cars parked around it that cost at least 200,000 yuan, but it was the only domestic low-end car like this, and the color was so bright that it was difficult not to attract attention.
The security guard standing at the door took a look at the little QQ, and his eyes showed disdain. Not to mention the good-looking sales staff standing at the door. In addition to contempt and disdain, one of the pretty saleswomen couldn't help covering her mouth and sneered: "Giggles, it's so funny, look at that little toy car..."
Another male salesman standing nearby laughed disdainfully: "These days, no one dares to come to visit BMW."
A relatively steady salesperson next to me whispered: "Okay, okay, pay attention to your image. If the boss sees you, your salary will be deducted again."
Several salesmen immediately calmed down their expressions. When Lin Kun and Zhang Xiaoya opened the door and came in, they all smiled and said: "Welcome..."
Then, there was nothing more to say. No one took the initiative to take the two of them to see the car, and no one took the initiative to ask: "Can you two help me?" A few people stood neatly at the door, like sculptures with sneers on their faces. Their thoughts were very simple. No one wanted to waste their saliva on another person who was obviously impossible to buy a car. Little did they know that just because of their snobbery, they lost a super big customer in vain.
Lin Kun and Zhang XiaoYa was a little confused about the situation. Neither of them had visited a 4S store before. Is it the same as visiting a supermarket? Which product do you like, can you just put it in the basket? But after all, buying a car is different from going to the supermarket. You need someone to guide and introduce you. This...
The two were wondering when a black Lexus car drove up from the door of the 4S store. A man and a woman got out of the car. They were dressed fashionably and jeweled. The woman wore large sunglasses that covered half of her face. She held a delicate orange handbag in her left hand. She held the man's arm in her right hand. The man had a large shiny gold chain tied around his neck and he also wore large sunglasses on his face.
This time, the quality was different. The salesmen at the door suddenly felt like they had been given a shot of blood. Their eyes lit up and they looked at the men and women coming towards them as if they had met the God of Wealth.
"Welcome!"
The same greeting dialogue, but the next step is completely different. A salesperson immediately stepped forward and smiled politely and respectfully: "Sir, Madam, do you have any car models that you are interested in?"
Another waitress also came forward and said with a smile: "Or, let's take the two of you to look at the models one by one first?"
